package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"math"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

// ErrPlanningSnapshotSourceInvalid distinguishes a malformed owner projection
// from a caller request error. It contains no private source values.
var ErrPlanningSnapshotSourceInvalid = errors.New("invalid planning snapshot owner source")

const (
	StudentPlanningSnapshotSchema       = "student-planning-snapshot.v1"
	MaximumPlanningSnapshotRequestBytes = 2 << 20
	MaximumPlanningSnapshotPayloadBytes = 128 << 20
)

type PlanningSnapshotTrigger struct {
	Kind          string `json:"kind"`
	Reason        string `json:"reason"`
	CorrelationID string `json:"correlation_id,omitempty"`
}
type PlanningSnapshotRequest struct {
	Targets        []LearningTargetRef     `json:"targets"`
	TriggerContext PlanningSnapshotTrigger `json:"trigger_context"`
}

// PlanningSnapshotSource is one consistent owner observation. It may carry
// existing private profile/path models only as inputs to the whitelist builder.
// It never carries answers, evidence bodies, workspace, or Runtime projections.
type PlanningSnapshotSource struct {
	StudentID        string
	RequestedTargets []LearningTargetRef
	Path             StudentLearningPath
	Context          StudentLearningContext
	Profile          StudentOnboarding
	Mastery          []StudentTargetMastery
	Evidence         []PlanningEvidenceReference
	ActivityFacts    []LessonActivityFact
	CourseBindings   []PlanningCourseActionBinding
	PracticeBindings []PracticeLearningActionBinding
	CapturedAt       time.Time
	PendingIntent    *HybridLearningIntentProjection
}

type PlanningEvidenceReference struct {
	StudentID             string                           `json:"-"`
	SourceKind            string                           `json:"source_kind"`
	SurfaceClassification string                           `json:"surface_classification,omitempty"`
	EvidenceID            string                           `json:"evidence_id"`
	LearningActionID      string                           `json:"learning_action_id,omitempty"`
	TaskID                string                           `json:"task_id,omitempty"`
	TaskInstanceID        string                           `json:"task_instance_id,omitempty"`
	TaskRevisionID        string                           `json:"task_revision_id,omitempty"`
	SubmissionID          string                           `json:"submission_id,omitempty"`
	Target                LearningTargetRef                `json:"target"`
	EvidenceClass         LearningEvidenceClass            `json:"evidence_class"`
	Outcome               LearningActionOutcome            `json:"outcome"`
	SupportContext        TeacherSupportContext            `json:"support_context"`
	Kind                  LearningActionTargetEvidenceKind `json:"kind"`
	HintsUsed             int                              `json:"hints_used"`
	MaxHintLevel          *int                             `json:"max_hint_level,omitempty"`
	InterventionUsed      bool                             `json:"intervention_used"`
	TeacherPolicyVersion  string                           `json:"teacher_policy_version"`
	MasteryPolicyVersion  string                           `json:"mastery_policy_version"`
	ReceiptHash           string                           `json:"receipt_hash,omitempty"`
	OccurredAt            time.Time                        `json:"occurred_at"`
}

type PlanningCourseActionBinding struct {
	StudentID          string              `json:"-"`
	LearningActionID   string              `json:"learning_action_id"`
	AnswerID           string              `json:"answer_id"`
	TaskID             string              `json:"task_id"`
	LearningPathItemID string              `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
	RequirementID      string              `json:"requirement_id"`
	LifecycleStatus    string              `json:"lifecycle_status"`
	AnswerStatus       int                 `json:"answer_status"`
	LearningTargets    []LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
	OpenedAt           time.Time           `json:"opened_at"`
	ClosedAt           *time.Time          `json:"closed_at,omitempty"`
}

// Each response type is an explicit whitelist. Private source fields such as
// GoalText, ReasonSummary and LessonContent have no destination in this DTO.
type PlanningSnapshotProfile struct {
	ProfileVersion         string   `json:"profile_version"`
	OwnerVersion           int64    `json:"owner_version"`
	DirectionCode          string   `json:"direction_code"`
	SelfAssessedExperience string   `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
	KnownStacks            []string `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          []string `json:"desired_stacks"`
	GoalCode               string   `json:"goal_code"`
	PreferredLanguage      string   `json:"preferred_language"`
	WeeklyMinutes          int      `json:"weekly_minutes"`
	PreferredPace          string   `json:"preferred_pace"`
}

type PlanningSnapshotPath struct {
	ID                     string                 `json:"learning_path_id"`
	CourseID               string                 `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode               string                 `json:"goal_code"`
	CourseFingerprint      string                 `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PolicyVersion          string                 `json:"policy_version"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion   string                 `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	Status                 LearningPathStatus     `json:"status"`
	IsPrimary              bool                   `json:"is_primary"`
	IsSelected             bool                   `json:"is_selected"`
	Version                int64                  `json:"path_version"`
	JourneyVersion         int64                  `json:"journey_version"`
	SelectedLearningPathID string                 `json:"selected_learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	Items                  []PlanningSnapshotItem `json:"items"`
}

type PlanningSnapshotItem struct {
	ID                 string                 `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
	LessonRevisionID   string                 `json:"lesson_revision_id,omitempty"`
	ReferenceType      string                 `json:"reference_type"`
	ReferenceID        string                 `json:"reference_id"`
	Position           int                    `json:"position"`
	Status             LearningPathItemStatus `json:"status"`
	Targets            []LearningTargetRef    `json:"targets"`
	FrozenRequirements []LessonRequirement    `json:"frozen_requirements"`
}

type PlanningSnapshotMastery struct {
	Target                  LearningTargetRef  `json:"target"`
	State                   TargetMasteryState `json:"state"`
	MasteryScore            float64            `json:"mastery_score"`
	Confidence              float64            `json:"confidence"`
	IndependentSuccessCount int                `json:"independent_success_count"`
	AssistedSuccessCount    int                `json:"assisted_success_count"`
	FailureCount            int                `json:"failure_count"`
	EvidenceCount           int                `json:"evidence_count"`
	PolicyVersion           string             `json:"policy_version"`
	LastSeenAt              *time.Time         `json:"last_seen_at,omitempty"`
	LastPracticedAt         *time.Time         `json:"last_practiced_at,omitempty"`
	LastFailedAt            *time.Time         `json:"last_failed_at,omitempty"`
}

type PlanningSnapshotActivityFact struct {
	ItemID           string    `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
	RequirementID    string    `json:"requirement_id"`
	Type             string    `json:"type"`
	SourceID         string    `json:"source_id"`
	SourceRevisionID string    `json:"source_revision_id,omitempty"`
	FactID           string    `json:"fact_id"`
	OccurredAt       time.Time `json:"occurred_at"`
}

type PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding struct {
	LearningActionID                string                                `json:"learning_action_id"`
	TaskInstanceID                  string                                `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID                  string                                `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest              string                                `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	LearningPathID                  string                                `json:"learning_path_id"`
	LearningPathItemID              string                                `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID                   string                                `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	SurfaceClassification           string                                `json:"surface_classification"`
	LifecycleStatus                 PracticeLearningActionLifecycleStatus `json:"lifecycle_status"`
	LearningTargets                 []LearningTargetRef                   `json:"learning_targets"`
	LearningPathVersionReservation  int64                                 `json:"learning_path_version_at_reservation"`
	LearningPathPositionReservation int                                   `json:"learning_path_position_at_reservation"`
}

// Student supplies bounded facts for Planner-owned quality/stability policy.
// No derived decision or permission is returned here; values remain null.
type PlanningSnapshotUnavailable struct {
	Status     string    `json:"status"`
	Value      *struct{} `json:"value"`
	ReasonCode string    `json:"reason_code"`
}
type PlanningSnapshotAvailability struct {
	EvidenceQuality     PlanningSnapshotUnavailable `json:"evidence_quality"`
	Stability           PlanningSnapshotUnavailable `json:"stability"`
	RuntimeHold         PlanningSnapshotUnavailable `json:"runtime_hold"`
	AutomaticAdaptation PlanningSnapshotUnavailable `json:"automatic_adaptation"`
	StudentPinning      PlanningSnapshotUnavailable `json:"student_pinning"`
}

type PlanningSnapshotReferences struct {
	LearnerRef     string `json:"learner_ref"`
	MasteryRef     string `json:"mastery_ref"`
	GoalRef        string `json:"goal_ref"`
	ConstraintsRef string `json:"constraints_ref"`
	SnapshotRef    string `json:"snapshot_ref"`
}
type StudentPlanningSnapshot struct {
	Schema           string                            `json:"schema"`
	StudentID        string                            `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID   string                            `json:"learning_path_id"`
	CapturedAt       time.Time                         `json:"captured_at"`
	TriggerContext   PlanningSnapshotTrigger           `json:"trigger_context"`
	References       PlanningSnapshotReferences        `json:"references"`
	RequestedTargets []LearningTargetRef               `json:"requested_targets"`
	Profile          PlanningSnapshotProfile           `json:"profile"`
	Path             PlanningSnapshotPath              `json:"path"`
	Mastery          []PlanningSnapshotMastery         `json:"mastery"`
	Evidence         []PlanningEvidenceReference       `json:"evidence"`
	ActivityFacts    []PlanningSnapshotActivityFact    `json:"activity_facts"`
	CourseBindings   []PlanningCourseActionBinding     `json:"course_bindings"`
	PracticeBindings []PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding `json:"practice_bindings"`
	Availability     PlanningSnapshotAvailability      `json:"availability"`
	PendingIntent    *HybridLearningIntentProjection   `json:"pending_intent,omitempty"`
}

// NormalizePlanningSnapshotTargets preserves the existing opaque target
// vocabulary, including an exact empty legacy version. It never derives one.
func NormalizePlanningSnapshotTargets(input []LearningTargetRef) ([]LearningTargetRef, error) {
	if len(input) < 1 || len(input) > 500 {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	result := make([]LearningTargetRef, len(input))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, target := range input {
		normalized, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(target)
		if err != nil || seen[targetIdentity(normalized)] {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		result[i] = normalized
		seen[targetIdentity(normalized)] = true
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return targetIdentity(result[i]) < targetIdentity(result[j]) })
	return result, nil
}
func NormalizePlanningSnapshotRequest(input PlanningSnapshotRequest) (PlanningSnapshotRequest, error) {
	targets, err := NormalizePlanningSnapshotTargets(input.Targets)
	trigger := input.TriggerContext
	if err != nil || !validPlanningTrace(trigger.Kind) || !validPlanningTrace(trigger.Reason) || (trigger.CorrelationID != "" && !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(trigger.CorrelationID)) {
		return PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.Targets = targets
	if raw, err := json.Marshal(input); err != nil || len(raw) > MaximumPlanningSnapshotRequestBytes {
		return PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}
func validPlanningTrace(value string) bool {
	return utf8.ValidString(value) && strings.TrimSpace(value) != ""
}

func BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source PlanningSnapshotSource, request PlanningSnapshotRequest) (StudentPlanningSnapshot, error) {
	request, err := NormalizePlanningSnapshotRequest(request)
	if err != nil || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(source.StudentID) || source.CapturedAt.IsZero() {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	sourceTargets, err := NormalizePlanningSnapshotTargets(source.RequestedTargets)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(sourceTargets, request.Targets) {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	profile, err := NormalizeStudentOnboarding(source.Profile)
	if err != nil || profile.StudentID != source.StudentID {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	path, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(source.Path)
	if err != nil || path.StudentID != source.StudentID {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	contextValue, err := NormalizeStudentLearningContext(source.Context)
	if err != nil || contextValue.StudentID != source.StudentID || contextValue.Version < 1 {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	result := StudentPlanningSnapshot{
		Schema: StudentPlanningSnapshotSchema, StudentID: source.StudentID, LearningPathID: path.ID, CapturedAt: source.CapturedAt.UTC(), TriggerContext: request.TriggerContext, RequestedTargets: request.Targets,
		Profile: PlanningSnapshotProfile{ProfileVersion: profile.ProfileVersion, OwnerVersion: profile.Version, DirectionCode: profile.DirectionCode, SelfAssessedExperience: profile.SelfAssessedExperience, KnownStacks: append([]string{}, profile.KnownStacks...), DesiredStacks: append([]string{}, profile.DesiredStacks...), GoalCode: profile.GoalCode, PreferredLanguage: profile.PreferredLanguage, WeeklyMinutes: profile.WeeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: profile.PreferredPace},
		Path:    PlanningSnapshotPath{ID: path.ID, CourseID: path.CourseID, GoalCode: path.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: path.CourseFingerprint, PolicyVersion: path.PolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: path.PlannerPolicyVersion, Status: path.Status, IsPrimary: path.IsPrimary, IsSelected: contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID == path.ID, Version: path.Version, JourneyVersion: contextValue.Version, SelectedLearningPathID: contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID, Items: []PlanningSnapshotItem{}},
		Mastery: []PlanningSnapshotMastery{}, Evidence: []PlanningEvidenceReference{}, ActivityFacts: []PlanningSnapshotActivityFact{}, CourseBindings: []PlanningCourseActionBinding{}, PracticeBindings: []PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding{}, Availability: planningSnapshotUnavailableSignals(),
	}
	sort.Strings(result.Profile.KnownStacks)
	sort.Strings(result.Profile.DesiredStacks)
	if source.PendingIntent != nil {
		intent := *source.PendingIntent
		if ValidateHybridLearningIntentProjection(intent, result) != nil {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		raw, err := json.Marshal(intent)
		if err != nil {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		var owned HybridLearningIntentProjection
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &owned) != nil {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		result.PendingIntent = &owned
	}
	for _, item := range path.Items {
		if !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(item.ID) {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		targets := append([]LearningTargetRef{}, item.Targets...)
		sortPlanningTargets(targets)
		result.Path.Items = append(result.Path.Items, PlanningSnapshotItem{ID: item.ID, LessonRevisionID: item.LessonRevisionID, ReferenceType: item.ReferenceType, ReferenceID: item.ReferenceID, Position: item.Position, Status: item.Status, Targets: targets, FrozenRequirements: append([]LessonRequirement{}, item.FrozenRequirements...)})
	}
	// Complete requested projection: real missing rows retain the existing
	// UNKNOWN semantics. No row is written, and no quality judgment is inferred.
	masteryByTarget := map[string]StudentTargetMastery{}
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, target := range request.Targets {
		allowed[targetIdentity(target)] = true
	}
	for _, m := range source.Mastery {
		target, e := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(m.Target)
		id := targetIdentity(target)
		if e != nil || m.StudentID != source.StudentID || !allowed[id] || masteryByTarget[id].StudentID != "" {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		m.Target = target
		if !validSnapshotMastery(m) {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		masteryByTarget[id] = m
	}
	for _, target := range request.Targets {
		m, found := masteryByTarget[targetIdentity(target)]
		if !found {
			m = StudentTargetMastery{StudentID: source.StudentID, Target: target, State: TargetMasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: MasteryPolicyVersion}
		}
		var seenAt *time.Time
		if !m.LastSeenAt.IsZero() {
			v := m.LastSeenAt.UTC()
			seenAt = &v
		}
		result.Mastery = append(result.Mastery, PlanningSnapshotMastery{Target: target, State: m.State, MasteryScore: m.MasteryScore, Confidence: m.Confidence, IndependentSuccessCount: m.IndependentSuccessCount, AssistedSuccessCount: m.AssistedSuccessCount, FailureCount: m.FailureCount, EvidenceCount: m.EvidenceCount, PolicyVersion: m.PolicyVersion, LastSeenAt: seenAt, LastPracticedAt: snapshotTime(m.LastPracticedAt), LastFailedAt: snapshotTime(m.LastFailedAt)})
	}
	for _, e := range source.Evidence {
		if e.StudentID != source.StudentID {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		normalized, err := normalizeSnapshotEvidence(e, allowed)
		if err != nil {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, err
		}
		result.Evidence = append(result.Evidence, normalized)
	}
	for _, fact := range source.ActivityFacts {
		if fact.StudentID != source.StudentID || fact.OccurredAt.IsZero() || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(fact.FactID) {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		requirement, found := snapshotRequirement(result.Path.Items, fact.ItemID, fact.RequirementID)
		if !found || requirement.Type != fact.Type || requirement.SourceReference.ID != fact.SourceID || requirement.SourceReference.RevisionID != fact.SourceRevisionID || !requirement.Satisfied {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		result.ActivityFacts = append(result.ActivityFacts, PlanningSnapshotActivityFact{ItemID: fact.ItemID, RequirementID: fact.RequirementID, Type: fact.Type, SourceID: fact.SourceID, SourceRevisionID: fact.SourceRevisionID, FactID: fact.FactID, OccurredAt: fact.OccurredAt.UTC()})
	}
	for _, binding := range source.CourseBindings {
		if binding.StudentID != source.StudentID {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if err := validateSnapshotCourseBinding(binding, result.Path.Items); err != nil {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, err
		}
		binding.LearningTargets = append([]LearningTargetRef{}, binding.LearningTargets...)
		sortPlanningTargets(binding.LearningTargets)
		binding.OpenedAt = binding.OpenedAt.UTC()
		binding.ClosedAt = snapshotTime(binding.ClosedAt)
		result.CourseBindings = append(result.CourseBindings, binding)
	}
	for _, binding := range source.PracticeBindings {
		b, err := NormalizePracticeLearningActionBinding(binding)
		if err != nil || b.StudentID != source.StudentID || b.LearningPathID != path.ID {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		projection := PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding{LearningActionID: b.LearningActionID, TaskInstanceID: b.TaskInstanceID, TaskRevisionID: b.TaskRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: b.TaskRevisionDigest, LearningPathID: b.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: b.LearningPathItemID, RequirementID: b.RequirementID, SurfaceClassification: b.SurfaceClassification, LifecycleStatus: b.LifecycleStatus, LearningTargets: append([]LearningTargetRef{}, b.LearningTargets...), LearningPathVersionReservation: b.LearningPathVersionReservation, LearningPathPositionReservation: b.LearningPathPositionReservation}
		sortPlanningTargets(projection.LearningTargets)
		if err := validateSnapshotPracticeBinding(projection, result.Path); err != nil {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, err
		}
		result.PracticeBindings = append(result.PracticeBindings, projection)
	}
	sortSnapshotCollections(&result)
	result.References, err = snapshotReferences(result)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot(result)
}

func snapshotTime(input *time.Time) *time.Time {
	if input == nil {
		return nil
	}
	v := input.UTC()
	return &v
}
func sortPlanningTargets(targets []LearningTargetRef) {
	sort.Slice(targets, func(i, j int) bool { return targetIdentity(targets[i]) < targetIdentity(targets[j]) })
}
func validSnapshotMastery(m StudentTargetMastery) bool {
	switch m.State {
	case TargetMasteryUnknown, TargetMasteryExposed, TargetMasteryUnderstood, TargetMasteryPracticed, TargetMasteryApplied, TargetMasteryMastered:
	default:
		return false
	}
	return m.PolicyVersion == MasteryPolicyVersion && finiteUnit(m.MasteryScore) && finiteUnit(m.Confidence) && m.IndependentSuccessCount >= 0 && m.AssistedSuccessCount >= 0 && m.FailureCount >= 0 && m.EvidenceCount >= 0 && m.IndependentSuccessCount <= m.EvidenceCount && m.AssistedSuccessCount <= m.EvidenceCount && m.FailureCount <= m.EvidenceCount && int64(m.IndependentSuccessCount)+int64(m.AssistedSuccessCount)+int64(m.FailureCount) == int64(m.EvidenceCount)
}
func finiteUnit(v float64) bool { return !math.IsNaN(v) && !math.IsInf(v, 0) && v >= 0 && v <= 1 }
func normalizeSnapshotEvidence(e PlanningEvidenceReference, allowed map[string]bool) (PlanningEvidenceReference, error) {
	t, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(e.Target)
	e.Target = t
	expected, kindErr := deriveTargetEvidenceKind(e.EvidenceClass, e.Outcome, e.SupportContext)
	if err != nil || !allowed[targetIdentity(t)] || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(e.EvidenceID) || kindErr != nil || e.Kind != expected || e.OccurredAt.IsZero() || !validLearningValue(e.TeacherPolicyVersion, 64) || e.MasteryPolicyVersion != MasteryPolicyVersion || e.HintsUsed < 0 || e.HintsUsed > 1000 || (e.HintsUsed == 0) != (e.MaxHintLevel == nil) || (e.MaxHintLevel != nil && (*e.MaxHintLevel < 0 || *e.MaxHintLevel > 7)) {
		return PlanningEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if e.SupportContext == TeacherSupportIndependent && (e.HintsUsed != 0 || e.InterventionUsed) {
		return PlanningEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
	}
	switch e.SourceKind {
	case "course_answer":
		if e.LearningActionID != e.EvidenceID || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(e.TaskID) || e.TaskInstanceID != "" || e.TaskRevisionID != "" || e.SubmissionID != "" || e.ReceiptHash != "" || e.SurfaceClassification != "" {
			return PlanningEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case "practice_v2", "practice_legacy":
		if e.SurfaceClassification != "" && e.SurfaceClassification != "practice" && e.SurfaceClassification != "project" {
			return PlanningEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if e.SourceKind == "practice_legacy" && e.SurfaceClassification != "" {
			return PlanningEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(e.TaskInstanceID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(e.TaskRevisionID) || e.SubmissionID != e.EvidenceID || !validPracticeLearningActionDigest(e.ReceiptHash) || e.EvidenceClass != LearningEvidenceApplication || e.Outcome != LearningActionPassed || (e.TaskID != "" && e.TaskID != e.TaskInstanceID) {
			return PlanningEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if e.SourceKind == "practice_v2" && !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(e.LearningActionID) || e.SourceKind == "practice_legacy" && e.LearningActionID != "" {
			return PlanningEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		return PlanningEvidenceReference{}, ErrValidation
	}
	e.OccurredAt = e.OccurredAt.UTC()
	if e.MaxHintLevel != nil {
		v := *e.MaxHintLevel
		e.MaxHintLevel = &v
	}
	return e, nil
}
func snapshotRequirement(items []PlanningSnapshotItem, itemID, requirementID string) (LessonRequirement, bool) {
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.ID == itemID {
			for _, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
				if r.ID == requirementID {
					return r, true
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return LessonRequirement{}, false
}
func validateSnapshotCourseBinding(b PlanningCourseActionBinding, items []PlanningSnapshotItem) error {
	if !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(b.LearningActionID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(b.AnswerID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(b.TaskID) || b.OpenedAt.IsZero() || b.AnswerStatus < StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress || b.AnswerStatus > StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if b.LifecycleStatus == string(LearningActionStatusOpen) {
		if b.ClosedAt != nil {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	} else if b.LifecycleStatus == string(LearningActionStatusClosed) {
		if b.ClosedAt == nil || b.ClosedAt.IsZero() || b.ClosedAt.Before(b.OpenedAt) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	} else {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	refs, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(b.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil || !PlanningSnapshotCanonicalEqual(refs, b.LearningTargets) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	requirement, found := snapshotRequirement(items, b.LearningPathItemID, b.RequirementID)
	if !found || (requirement.Type != "quiz_passed" && requirement.Type != "task_passed") || requirement.SourceReference.ID != b.TaskID {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
func validateSnapshotPracticeBinding(b PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding, path PlanningSnapshotPath) error {
	if !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(b.LearningActionID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(b.TaskInstanceID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(b.TaskRevisionID) || !validPracticeLearningActionDigest(b.TaskRevisionDigest) || b.LearningPathID != path.ID || b.LearningPathVersionReservation < 1 || b.LearningPathVersionReservation > path.Version || b.LearningPathPositionReservation < 0 || (b.SurfaceClassification != "practice" && b.SurfaceClassification != "project") {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	switch b.LifecycleStatus {
	case PracticeLearningActionReserved, PracticeLearningActionOpen, PracticeLearningActionCancelled, PracticeLearningActionClosed:
	default:
		return ErrValidation
	}
	refs, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(b.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil || len(refs) == 0 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	for _, t := range refs {
		if t.Version == "" {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if b.LearningPathItemID != "" || b.RequirementID != "" {
		r, ok := snapshotRequirement(path.Items, b.LearningPathItemID, b.RequirementID)
		if !ok || r.Type != "practice_completed" || r.SourceReference.ID != b.TaskRevisionID || r.SourceReference.RevisionID != b.TaskRevisionID {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	} else {
		found := false
		for _, item := range path.Items {
			if item.ReferenceType == "practice" && item.ReferenceID == b.TaskRevisionID {
				found = true
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func planningSnapshotUnavailableSignals() PlanningSnapshotAvailability {
	unavailable := func(reason string) PlanningSnapshotUnavailable {
		return PlanningSnapshotUnavailable{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", ReasonCode: reason}
	}
	derived := PlanningSnapshotUnavailable{Status: "DERIVED_BY_PLANNER", ReasonCode: "PLANNER_POLICY_HYBRID_V1"}
	return PlanningSnapshotAvailability{EvidenceQuality: derived, Stability: derived, RuntimeHold: unavailable("RUNTIME_HOLD_NOT_OBSERVED"), AutomaticAdaptation: unavailable("AUTOMATIC_ADAPTATION_NOT_DEFINED"), StudentPinning: unavailable("STUDENT_PINNING_NOT_DEFINED")}
}
func sortSnapshotCollections(s *StudentPlanningSnapshot) {
	sort.Slice(s.Evidence, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshotEvidenceKey(s.Evidence[i]) < snapshotEvidenceKey(s.Evidence[j]) })
	sort.Slice(s.ActivityFacts, func(i, j int) bool { return snapshotFactKey(s.ActivityFacts[i]) < snapshotFactKey(s.ActivityFacts[j]) })
	sort.Slice(s.CourseBindings, func(i, j int) bool {
		return s.CourseBindings[i].LearningActionID < s.CourseBindings[j].LearningActionID
	})
	sort.Slice(s.PracticeBindings, func(i, j int) bool {
		return s.PracticeBindings[i].TaskInstanceID < s.PracticeBindings[j].TaskInstanceID
	})
}
func snapshotEvidenceKey(e PlanningEvidenceReference) string {
	return e.SourceKind + "\x00" + e.EvidenceID + "\x00" + targetIdentity(e.Target)
}
func snapshotFactKey(f PlanningSnapshotActivityFact) string { return f.Type + "\x00" + f.FactID }

// NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot validates a whitelisted response without
// repairing hashes, assigning business revisions, or inferring missing signals.
func NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot(s StudentPlanningSnapshot) (StudentPlanningSnapshot, error) {
	if s.Schema != StudentPlanningSnapshotSchema || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(s.StudentID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(s.LearningPathID) || s.Path.ID != s.LearningPathID || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(s.Path.CourseID) || s.CapturedAt.IsZero() {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	request, err := NormalizePlanningSnapshotRequest(PlanningSnapshotRequest{Targets: s.RequestedTargets, TriggerContext: s.TriggerContext})
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(request.Targets, s.RequestedTargets) {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	p, err := NormalizeStudentOnboarding(StudentOnboarding{StudentID: s.StudentID, ProfileVersion: s.Profile.ProfileVersion, Version: s.Profile.OwnerVersion, DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, SelfAssessedExperience: s.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience, KnownStacks: s.Profile.KnownStacks, DesiredStacks: s.Profile.DesiredStacks, GoalCode: s.Profile.GoalCode, PreferredLanguage: s.Profile.PreferredLanguage, WeeklyMinutes: s.Profile.WeeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: s.Profile.PreferredPace, CreatedAt: s.CapturedAt, UpdatedAt: s.CapturedAt})
	if err != nil || p.ProfileVersion != s.Profile.ProfileVersion || p.DirectionCode != s.Profile.DirectionCode || p.SelfAssessedExperience != s.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience || p.GoalCode != s.Profile.GoalCode || p.PreferredLanguage != s.Profile.PreferredLanguage || p.PreferredPace != s.Profile.PreferredPace || !reflect.DeepEqual(p.KnownStacks, s.Profile.KnownStacks) || !reflect.DeepEqual(p.DesiredStacks, s.Profile.DesiredStacks) {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if s.Path.Version < 1 || s.Path.JourneyVersion < 1 || !optionalJourneyUUID(s.Path.SelectedLearningPathID) || !validLearningPathStatus(s.Path.Status) || s.Path.IsSelected != (s.Path.SelectedLearningPathID == s.Path.ID) || (s.Path.IsPrimary && s.Path.Status != LearningPathStatusActive) || s.Path.GoalCode == "" || len(s.Path.GoalCode) > 64 || s.Path.CourseFingerprint == "" || len(s.Path.CourseFingerprint) > 128 || s.Path.PolicyVersion != LearningPathPolicyVersion || s.Path.PlannerPolicyVersion == "" || len(s.Path.PlannerPolicyVersion) > 64 || len(s.Path.Items) < 1 || len(s.Path.Items) > 500 {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	seenItems := map[string]bool{}
	readyCount := 0
	for i, item := range s.Path.Items {
		if item.Position != i || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(item.ID) || seenItems[item.ID] || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(item.ReferenceID) || (item.ReferenceType != "lesson" && item.ReferenceType != "practice") || !validPathItemStatus(item.Status) {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		seenItems[item.ID] = true
		if item.Status == LearningPathItemReady {
			readyCount++
		}
		refs, e := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(item.Targets)
		if e != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(refs, item.Targets) || ValidateLessonAssignment(LearningPathItem{ID: item.ID, ReferenceType: item.ReferenceType, LessonRevisionID: item.LessonRevisionID, FrozenRequirements: item.FrozenRequirements}) != nil {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if readyCount > 1 || len(s.Mastery) != len(request.Targets) {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	for i, m := range s.Mastery {
		if m.Target != request.Targets[i] || !validSnapshotMastery(StudentTargetMastery{Target: m.Target, State: m.State, MasteryScore: m.MasteryScore, Confidence: m.Confidence, IndependentSuccessCount: m.IndependentSuccessCount, AssistedSuccessCount: m.AssistedSuccessCount, FailureCount: m.FailureCount, EvidenceCount: m.EvidenceCount, PolicyVersion: m.PolicyVersion}) || (m.LastSeenAt != nil && m.LastSeenAt.IsZero()) || (m.LastPracticedAt != nil && m.LastPracticedAt.IsZero()) || (m.LastFailedAt != nil && m.LastFailedAt.IsZero()) {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		allowed[targetIdentity(m.Target)] = true
	}
	evidenceKeys := map[string]bool{}
	for _, e := range s.Evidence {
		_, err := normalizeSnapshotEvidence(e, allowed)
		key := snapshotEvidenceKey(e)
		if err != nil || (e.StudentID != "" && e.StudentID != s.StudentID) || evidenceKeys[key] {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		evidenceKeys[key] = true
	}
	factKeys := map[string]bool{}
	for _, f := range s.ActivityFacts {
		r, ok := snapshotRequirement(s.Path.Items, f.ItemID, f.RequirementID)
		key := snapshotFactKey(f)
		if !ok || !r.Satisfied || f.Type != r.Type || f.SourceID != r.SourceReference.ID || f.SourceRevisionID != r.SourceReference.RevisionID || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(f.FactID) || f.OccurredAt.IsZero() || factKeys[key] {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		factKeys[key] = true
	}
	courseKeys := map[string]bool{}
	for _, b := range s.CourseBindings {
		if (b.StudentID != "" && b.StudentID != s.StudentID) || validateSnapshotCourseBinding(b, s.Path.Items) != nil || courseKeys[b.LearningActionID] {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		courseKeys[b.LearningActionID] = true
	}
	practiceKeys := map[string]bool{}
	for _, b := range s.PracticeBindings {
		if validateSnapshotPracticeBinding(b, s.Path) != nil || practiceKeys[b.TaskInstanceID] {
			return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
		}
		practiceKeys[b.TaskInstanceID] = true
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(s.Availability, planningSnapshotUnavailableSignals()) {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if s.PendingIntent != nil && ValidateHybridLearningIntentProjection(*s.PendingIntent, s) != nil {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	refs, err := snapshotReferences(s)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(refs, s.References) {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(s)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > MaximumPlanningSnapshotPayloadBytes {
		return StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return s, nil
}

func snapshotReferences(s StudentPlanningSnapshot) (PlanningSnapshotReferences, error) {
	// Marshal/parse creates an owned whitelist copy, so sorting the canonical
	// projections cannot mutate protected source models or response arrays.
	raw, err := json.Marshal(s)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > MaximumPlanningSnapshotPayloadBytes {
		return PlanningSnapshotReferences{}, ErrValidation
	}
	var canonical StudentPlanningSnapshot
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical) != nil {
		return PlanningSnapshotReferences{}, ErrValidation
	}
	sort.Strings(canonical.Profile.KnownStacks)
	sort.Strings(canonical.Profile.DesiredStacks)
	sortSnapshotCollections(&canonical)
	for i := range canonical.Path.Items {
		item := &canonical.Path.Items[i]
		sortPlanningTargets(item.Targets)
		sort.Slice(item.FrozenRequirements, func(i, j int) bool { return item.FrozenRequirements[i].ID < item.FrozenRequirements[j].ID })
	}
	for i := range canonical.CourseBindings {
		b := &canonical.CourseBindings[i]
		sortPlanningTargets(b.LearningTargets)
		b.OpenedAt = time.Time{}
		b.ClosedAt = nil
	}
	for i := range canonical.PracticeBindings {
		sortPlanningTargets(canonical.PracticeBindings[i].LearningTargets)
	}
	for i := range canonical.Mastery {
		canonical.Mastery[i].LastSeenAt = nil
		canonical.Mastery[i].LastPracticedAt = nil
		canonical.Mastery[i].LastFailedAt = nil
	}
	refs := PlanningSnapshotReferences{}
	refs.GoalRef, err = planningSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID, ProfileVersion string
		OwnerVersion                      int64
		GoalCode                          string
	}{"student-planning-goal-ref.v1", s.StudentID, canonical.Profile.ProfileVersion, canonical.Profile.OwnerVersion, canonical.Profile.GoalCode})
	if err != nil {
		return refs, err
	}
	refs.ConstraintsRef, err = planningSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID, ProfileVersion string
		OwnerVersion                      int64
		Language                          string
		WeeklyMinutes                     int
		Pace                              string
	}{"student-planning-constraints-ref.v1", s.StudentID, canonical.Profile.ProfileVersion, canonical.Profile.OwnerVersion, canonical.Profile.PreferredLanguage, canonical.Profile.WeeklyMinutes, canonical.Profile.PreferredPace})
	if err != nil {
		return refs, err
	}
	refs.LearnerRef, err = planningSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID string
		Profile           PlanningSnapshotProfile
		Path              PlanningSnapshotPath
		ActivityFacts     []PlanningSnapshotActivityFact
		CourseBindings    []PlanningCourseActionBinding
		PracticeBindings  []PlanningSnapshotPracticeBinding
		Availability      PlanningSnapshotAvailability
		PendingIntent     *HybridLearningIntentProjection `json:"pending_intent,omitempty"`
	}{"student-learner-planning-ref.v1", s.StudentID, canonical.Profile, canonical.Path, canonical.ActivityFacts, canonical.CourseBindings, canonical.PracticeBindings, canonical.Availability, canonical.PendingIntent})
	if err != nil {
		return refs, err
	}
	refs.MasteryRef, err = planningSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID string
		Targets           []LearningTargetRef
		Mastery           []PlanningSnapshotMastery
		Evidence          []PlanningEvidenceReference
	}{"student-planning-mastery-ref.v1", s.StudentID, canonical.RequestedTargets, canonical.Mastery, canonical.Evidence})
	if err != nil {
		return refs, err
	}
	refs.SnapshotRef, err = planningSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID, PathID string
		Targets                   []LearningTargetRef
		References                PlanningSnapshotReferences
	}{StudentPlanningSnapshotSchema, s.StudentID, s.LearningPathID, canonical.RequestedTargets, refs})
	return refs, err
}
func planningSnapshotDigest(value any) (string, error) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > MaximumPlanningSnapshotPayloadBytes {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

// PlanningSnapshotCanonicalEqual compares typed wire projections rather than
// Go nil/empty representations of fields omitted from their JSON contract.
func PlanningSnapshotCanonicalEqual(left, right any) bool {
	a, e := json.Marshal(left)
	b, f := json.Marshal(right)
	return e == nil && f == nil && bytes.Equal(a, b)
}
